# frostmoln_appgw_versions (Data Source)

The Application Gateway data-plane engine versions.

Use `launchable` to decide what you may create a gateway on — it is computed by the server from the version's lifecycle status. **Do not re-derive it from `status`**: the rule is the platform's, and a configuration that reimplements it is one lifecycle change away from selecting a version the server refuses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Obey `launchable` rather than re-deriving it from `status`: the rule is the
# platform's, and a configuration that reimplements it is one lifecycle change
# away from selecting a version the server refuses.

data "frostmoln_appgw_versions" "available" {
  launchable_only = true
}

output "default_engine_version" {
  value = data.frostmoln_appgw_versions.available.default
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `launchable_only` (Boolean) Return only versions a new gateway may be created on. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `default` (String) The version a gateway gets when none is named. Empty if the catalog has no default.
- `versions` (Attributes List) The engine versions in the catalog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `end_of_life` (String) When support ends. Empty if not scheduled.
- `engine` (String) The data-plane engine.
- `id` (String) The catalog row's id.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the catalog default.
- `launchable` (Boolean) Whether a new gateway may be created on it. Server-computed — obey it.
- `managed_ruleset_version_default` (String) The managed WAF ruleset version this engine version ships with.
- `release_notes_url` (String) Where to read what changed.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status: `innovation`, `current`, `supported`, `deprecated` or `eol`.
- `version` (String) The version string.
